data.rationale: Nutrunner M-06 at F10 reads 96.3 Nm vs 110-130 Nm spec, 3 bad in a row. W-16 stops tool use and swaps/recalibrates per SOP-TORQUE-01 §2; W-20 re-audits all joints fastened since last good audit before cars leave.
